utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow, right? I can grab the back seat if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, it’s still on for tomorrow. Back seat works fine, and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll see you tomorrow then. I’ll make sure I’m ready on time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what time are we leaving?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Around 8. I’ll text you if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, just text me if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the carpool is still on for tomorrow, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, as long as the timing still works out. I just want to make sure we have enough room and no one gets left waiting.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, everyone still has a seat then?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool. I think I can take my turn Tuesday, unless I’ve mixed up the days again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tuesday works. I’ve got the carpool marked down unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll keep Tuesday clear. I’ll let you know right away if I remember anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you confirm the pickup time and who’s included in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it’s 8:30, and it’s me, you, and Leo in the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, just to confirm, is 8:30 the pickup time for all three of us?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in, but I’m probably a few minutes late. Save me a spot in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I’ve got you. I’ll keep a spot open and we’ll roll a few minutes later if needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, I’ll be there soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: How about 7:30? That should give us a little cushion.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 7:30 works for me. I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the pickup spots if you want. Who’s riding with whom?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think it’s Mia with Jordan, and Eli with Sam. I’ll double-check the exact pickup spots with you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ll note Mia with Jordan and Eli with Sam, then wait for the exact pickup spots.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Quinn, the carpool’s still on — I heard Maya’s just waiting to confirm the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll text Maya and see if she can lock in the pickup time now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, then I’ll keep an ear out in case Maya confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, are we still on for the carpool this morning?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yep, I’m still on for it. I’ll be ready in a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be ready too. See you in a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can do the morning run.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks. I’ll get the afternoon run sorted from my side.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll keep the morning run covered.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli — I’ll add your name to the carpool list and send the pickup times later today.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You’re welcome, Uli. I’ll send the pickup times later today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool might be a little different this week, but I’m still trying to get the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I know, right? I’ll check with the others and let you know as soon as I get the confirmed plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late — I can still make the carpool, just tell me the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll tell you the pickup time now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, just send it over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can do that. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Morning works for me. Maybe around 8:15?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, 8:15 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks. I’ll text you the pickup address and time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—send me the address and time when you can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check on the carpool and see if we need one more driver or a different pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check whether we need to adjust the pickup time too, so everyone can make it without rushing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the carpool. I think I missed the update, what changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I updated the pickup time, and now Priya’s covering the afternoon leg instead of me. I can send you the exact route if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, send me the exact route and I’ll follow the new pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can take the next run if you want, just tell me who’s bringing the kids.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll take the next one if you cover the following run.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll cover the following run.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: How about 8:00 AM?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 8:00 AM works for me. I'll be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Can we check the pickup times first? I want to make sure the carpool won’t run late.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure. What pickup times are we using?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s use the earliest pickup window we can and keep the route short so we don’t slip behind.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can ask around and line up a carpool spot for you if you need one.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That'd be great, thanks. Let me know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll text you the pickup spot as soon as I’ve lined it up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take the 3:15 pickup if that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, that still works for me. Thanks, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll swing by at 3:15.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell. I’ll keep the carpool list updated and make sure everyone knows the pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, thanks. I’ll go by what you send me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, I’ll send the latest pickup times and let you know if anything changes.
